description: This Java class defines an Android activity 'PlayerSetupActivity' that manages a multi-step user interface for setting up player information in a game. It includes UI initialization, button setup, animated transitions between setup screens, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: PlayerSetupActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing a multi-step user interface for game player setup, including animated transitions and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and prepares animation listeners.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Overrides activity finish to disable transition animations.

methods.name: setupButton
methods.description: Configures a button with touch animations.

methods.name: buttonClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks, animates button, and transitions between setup screens.

methods.name: setupNumberButton
methods.description: Creates a number button with random color and styling.

methods.name: popChildrenIn
methods.description: Animates child views to pop in sequentially.

methods.name: slideToNext
methods.description: Animates transition from current view to next view with skew and slide effects.
